recipe.criteria: Overhand L-sit pull-up, straight horizontal legs maintained throughout. Start with extended arms, pull chin above bar, return under control; 3.5 seconds up, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down. Entry into L-sit omitted.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
